findings: Breadth-first traversal uses path/File directory checks without a visited physical-identity set or explicit depth/entry budget. It retains per-folder lists of all files, including nonmedia, before a second statistics pass; memory is not bounded by media count alone. Android symlink reachability and actual memory costs untested.

isSafeDestination rejects startsWith externalRoot/Android case-insensitively without a component boundary, excluding similarly named sibling folders too. Dot-directory and localized To Edit exclusion differs from HiddenFileFilter underscore/hyphen policy.

Single-pass scan omits permanentlySortedFolders and counts only unprocessed media. Its allDiscoveredFiles contains processed media but not files under permanently sorted folder entries. Other global-discovery methods remain unread.

findViableTargetFolders includes only directories containing no direct files, then descends all subdirectories. Stage-two cache upsert can interleave with another refresh; no shared generation guard appears in these methods.

handleFolderRename updates only the exact old folder cache row, not descendant paths or signature caches, and uses delete+insert without a transaction. External filesystem rename may already be complete; callers remain to inspect.
getFolderExistence uses exists rather than isDirectory. Folder-aggregate change detection does not include content timestamps, consistent with prior same-size/count invalidation concern.
